findings.claim_or_location: [15] salicylic-acid RCT, PMID 14708455 — cited first author 'Liu H, et al.'; used to ground 'chloroxylenol 0.5% + salicylic acid 2% cream matched benzoyl peroxide 5% gel (62%/56% vs 60%/54%)' in section A.3 (Beta-hydroxy acid).
findings.issue: Author surname does NOT match the cited source. PMID 14708455 resolves to Boutli F, et al., 'Comparison of chloroxylenol 0.5% plus salicylic acid 2% cream and benzoyl peroxide 5% gel in the treatment of acne vulgaris: a randomized double-blind study,' Drugs Exp Clin Res 2003;29(3):101-9 — first author is BOUTLI, not 'Liu H'. The author left this as an un-fetched placeholder author and flagged it; verification confirms the surname is fabricated/incorrect. The PMID is valid and the numerical claims (62%/56% vs 60%/54%, n=37, 12-week double-blind) match the actual record, but the citation as written attributes the source to the wrong author and omits journal/year.
